content: GCC bilingual AR/EN guidance (AivenSoft Jan 2026; iTitans; Stackzeno) treats bilingualism as a Gulf business requirement, not a plugin: native labels العربية/English (no flags), switcher preserves current page, persist locale, subdirectory /en/ /ar/, hreflang, dir=rtl, content parity. Live GCC event-agency sites surveyed (Spectrum UAE, Al Safa, Beyond DXB, Arvento Edge) ship English-only UIs despite claiming bilingual teams — so first-class RTL with content parity is rare in this vertical and is a competitive gap, while still being expected by regional corporate buyers.
